verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the Events API, intended for generating helper SDKs. That is a developer building block that users could load into their own tools, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Nothing in the pack documents a try-it console, in-browser request execution, or runnable code samples, and the Platform and Profile API pages carry no spec at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
